skills.name: Falling Shadow (落影)
skills.line: I believe I see evil everywhere I look.
skills.description:
Ungaikyou casts the power of chaos at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of their attack.
While in Yang state, this skill changes to Dharma.

skills.name: Dharma (曇無)
skills.description:
Ungaikyou casts the power of an artifact to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 200% of their DEF. Also increases the move of an ally at the beginning of the turn order by 20%.
While in Yin state, this skill changes to Fallen Shadow.

skills.name: Shifting of the Sky (闘転)
skills.line: The dawn breaks and the world wakes up for the first time.
skills.description:
Ungaikyou lives in the Mirror Realm where their 2 faces are independent on each other. They can change between their Yin/Yang states. Their starting HP is halved. The HP in Yin and Yang states compliment to each other.
;
:
;Upon Usage
:Ungaikyou enters the Yang state and inverts their HP to Yang's HP. Also increases their speed by 100, lasts for 1 turn. Each subsequent use of this skill permanently increases the onibi cost by 2.
;Mirror Realm (鏡の世界)
:Ungaikyo cannot be healed, but will 50% of healing effects are converted into a shield that lasts for 2 turns.
;Yin/Yang (陰/陽)
:Yin/Yang are the 2 unique states that belong to Ungaikyou. When in Yin state, their ATK is increased by 200% of their initial DEF, and Yang state increases DEF by 10% of their initial ATK. When in Yang state, their DEF is increased by 10% of their initial ATK. Their HP in the Yin and Yang states compliment to each other. If Ungaikyou receives damage while in the Yin state, Yin state's HP will decrease while Yang state's HP will increase and vice versa. Their starting HP is halved, each state starts battle with 50% HP.
At the start of the battle, if Ungaikyou's initial ATK is more than 500% of their initial DEF, they will enter the Yin state; otherwise, they enter the Yang state.

skills.name: Shifting of the Stars (昭回)
skills.line: The sun sets and the old friend returns.
skills.description:
;Upon Usage
:Ungaikyou enters the Yin state and inverts their HP to Yin's HP. Also increases their SPD by 100, lasts for 1 turn. Each subsequent use of this skill permanently increases the onibi cost by 2.

skills.name: World Purge (雲岸清空)
skills.line: Dust regularly to avoid it accumulating.
skills.description:
To cleanse all filthy from the world, Ungaikyou attacks all enemies dealing damage equal to 131% of their ATK. Also has a 100% base chance to inflict Mirror's Wrath on them, lasts until the end of the round. They then send out a Black Lotus plunging upon 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 131% of their ATK.
While in Yang state, this skill changes to Painful Life. ;Mirror's Wrath (鏡怒) : :'''Debuff, Status''': This effect is consumed the next time the inflicted enemy receives a dispellable buff to negate it.

upgrades.text: Damage for Cleansing and Black Lotus increases to 135%
Damage for Cleansing and Black Lotus increases to 139%.
Damage for Cleansing and Black Lotus increases to 145%.
For each 30% of HP decreased in Yin state, Black Lotus deals an additional attack.

skills.name: Painful Life (苦海浮生)
skills.line: To have a heart as clear as a mirror and to show compassion.
skills.description:
Ungaikyou gains Mirror's Protection while in Yang state.
While in Yin state, this skill changes to World Purge. ;Upon Usage :Ungaikyou grants Mirror's Protection to an ally, lasts until the end of the round. Up to 2 allies can have Mirror's Protection at the same time. Also increases the move bar of all allies by 20%. All Mirror's Protections are when entering Yang state. ;Mirror's Protection (鏡護) : :'''Buff, Status''': When inflicted with a debuff or a control effect, 1 will be immediately dispelled and increases the move bar by 10%. This dispel effect can only be triggered once each turn. When this effect is triggered, restores the ally with the lowest HP by 240% of Ungaikyou's DEF. When an ally loses Mirror's Protection, they gain Mirror Shield. ;Mirror Shield (鏡盾) : :'''Buff, Status''': Shield that can absorb damage equal to 680% Ungaikyou's max DEF, lasts for 2 turns.

upgrades.text: '''Mirror's Protection''': Number of debuffs or control effect that can be dispelled increases to 2.
'''Mirror's Protection''': Boost to move bar increases to 20%.
For each 30% of HP decreased in Yang state, onibi cost will be decreased by 1.

bio.condition: With Ungaikyou win 30 times in PVP, Practice or Spar.
